about: Live poses of the rig-w2 sc-turn-left-oncoming PC drives at 43b4109 (the real LessonPlayShell, Chromium 1440x900, the same controller as the phone drives): dump.samples of .audit-frames/rig-w2/sc-turn-left-oncoming/pc-L1.json and pc-L3.json, one row per SimTick the shell fed applyTick. Columns t, x, y, headingDeg, speedKmh, gear, indicator (0 off, -1 left, 1 right); rounded to 1e-4. The first dump row (the pose (0,0) before the car existed) is dropped and its time kept as preSpawnSampleSec. Both drives printed a measured «Интервал: зави при …» under the ✓ turn (the PC half of sc-turn-left-oncoming:d079e687 clause 5); round 2 uses them for the verifier's 420-cell early-stop band.

pc-L1.printed: Интервал: зави при 34.3 с — над нормата от 4 секунди, точно така се преценява.

pc-L3.printed: Интервал: зави при 39.3 с — над нормата от 4 секунди, точно така се преценява.
